title: Luxury Essentials For Small Bathrooms
bodyHtml:
Luxury Meets Practicality in Even the Smallest Spaces

Studio Bagno’s Luxury Small Bathroom Essentials collection is designed to prove that even the most compact spaces can be transformed into stunning, highly functional retreats.

From sleek basins to space-saving toilets and even statement baths, we’ve got everything you need to make the most of your small bathroom.

Explore the Small Bathroom Collection

A Deep Collection Designed for Small Spaces

Whether you’re working with a petite powder room or a cozy ensuite, our collection has you covered. Choose from wall-hung and vanity-top basins, floor-mount and wall-hung toilets, and in-wall cisterns paired with a range of minimalist flush plates.

Each piece is thoughtfully designed to maximize space without sacrificing style or performance.

Introducing Our New Small Bathroom Baths

Now, even the tiniest floorplans can include a stunning statement piece. We’re excited to introduce two brand-new small bathroom baths to our collection.

Designed to fit snugly into compact spaces, these baths combine luxurious aesthetics with practical dimensions, so you can enjoy a spa-like experience with limited space.

Make Your Space, Yours

Our collection is more than just space-saving—it’s about creating a bathroom that feels luxurious, functional, and uniquely yours. Every fixture is crafted with premium materials, innovative designs, and a focus on maximizing usability.

Plus, with a range of finishes and styles, you can mix and match to create a cohesive look that reflects your personal taste.

Explore Our Elevated Small Bathrooms Collection

Explore our Collection online or visit our nationwide distribution partners to see the pieces in person. With so many options and fast delivery times, there’s never been a better time to upgrade your space.

See complete specification and more images by clicking the button below, or call us on (02) 9601 1948 to organise a viewing in our showroom or one of our nationwide distributors.
